label: preparing
what: A deliberately quiet, coordinated preparation for an 18:00 event at the great hall, including lighting and table arrangements; the mayor was told it was an inspection, but the secrecy and coordination suggest a surprise gathering/celebration. The builder requested the official inspection, Freight directed securing entrances and a shutter and keeping preparations quiet until 18:00, while reports place the baker, innkeeper, neighbour, builder, and Freight together discussing it. The secretary knows of and assists with scheduling/coordination.
